ResponseEnvelope: Standard API response wrapper (status, payload, errors) — used by every controller and service
TransactionDTO: GOD DTO carrying full transaction state; mutated across layers — the central coupling object
MoneyAmount: Monetary value object (amount, currency, scale) — shared everywhere money flows
MerchantDTO: Merchant master snapshot passed between domains
AccountingEntry: Double-entry accounting posting structure — couples finance to payments/compliance
AuditContext: Cross-cutting audit/correlation context threaded through call chains
PayRequest: Inbound request payload of the payments domain
PayResponse: Outbound response payload of the payments domain
PayEntity: JPA persistence entity of the payments domain
